# NUO AI

> NUO AI is a free Shopify app for cart upsells, cross-sells, gift-with-purchase (GWP), BOGO / Buy X Get Y offers, and AI-matched product recommendations. It includes real-time funnel analytics and automated A/B testing.

## Key facts

- Category: Shopify app — cart upsell, cross-sell, and promotions
- Price: Free — every feature included. No paid tier, no order cap, no revenue share.
- Rating: 5.0 on the Shopify App Store
- Shopify App Store listing: https://apps.shopify.com/ordermax-1
- Company: Manhattan, New York, NY, United States
- Core capabilities: adaptive storefront widgets (auto-match store theme), gift-with-purchase and BOGO/Buy X Get Y campaigns, AI product recommendations, real-time offer-funnel analytics, automated A/B testing, Shopify Sidekick integration for conversational campaign management

- [Offer priority rules](https://ordermax.io/features/offer-priority-rules/): deciding which offer fires when several qualify; distinct from Shopify's product/order/shipping discount combination settings
- [Customer segment targeting](https://ordermax.io/features/customer-segment-targeting/): different offers for new, lapsed and frequent shoppers; why gifts segment better than percentage discounts
- [Product page offer widget](https://ordermax.io/features/product-page-offer-widget/): offers on the product page as a theme app block; product page changes selection, cart changes spend
- [Volume discounts](https://ordermax.io/features/volume-discounts/): volume discounts and quantity breaks; tier design, per-variant vs per-product scope, and margin floors
- [Mix and match bundle](https://ordermax.io/features/mix-and-match-bundle/): any-N-from-a-set bundles; fixed price needs a narrow price band, percentage off tolerates a wide one
- [Build your own bundle](https://ordermax.io/features/build-your-own-bundle/): BYOB slot-based bundle builders; pre-filled recommended boxes materially raise completion
- [Offer funnel analytics](https://ordermax.io/features/offer-funnel-analytics/): offer funnels (viewed, accepted, checkout started, order placed); revenue influenced is an upper bound, not incremental revenue
- [Offer ab testing](https://ordermax.io/features/offer-ab-testing/): A/B testing offers; threshold tests and holdouts first, judged on revenue per session rather than acceptance rate
- [Adaptive theme styling](https://ordermax.io/features/adaptive-theme-styling/): theme-matched widgets via theme app blocks; no Liquid edits and nothing left behind on uninstall
- [Bogos Alternatives](https://ordermax.io/compare/bogos-alternatives/): BOGOS alternatives; BOGOS's free plan is 30 orders lifetime (one-time) and its first paid tier is $29.99/mo, per its listing
- [Selleasy Alternatives](https://ordermax.io/compare/selleasy-alternatives/): Selleasy alternatives; Selleasy's 50-orders/mo free cap counts total store orders, not app-influenced orders
- [Icart Alternatives](https://ordermax.io/compare/icart-alternatives/): iCart alternatives; iCart gives 100 free orders for the lifetime of the store and replaces the cart drawer itself
- [Honeycomb Alternatives](https://ordermax.io/compare/honeycomb-alternatives/): Honeycomb alternatives; Honeycomb caps on 100 funnel views/mo (impressions, not orders) and its first paid tier is $54.99/mo
- [Wiser Ai Alternatives](https://ordermax.io/compare/wiser-ai-alternatives/): Wiser AI alternatives; Wiser AI is free to 50 orders/mo then $9/mo, and is a recommendation engine rather than a promotions engine
- [Essential Upsell Alternatives](https://ordermax.io/compare/essential-upsell-alternatives/): Essential Upsell alternatives; Essential's free plan ends at $100 of app-generated revenue, so a well-performing app exhausts it quickly
- [Shopify buy x get y not working](https://ordermax.io/blog/shopify-buy-x-get-y-not-working/): nine causes a Shopify Buy X Get Y discount does not apply, ordered by frequency; the top cause is that Shopify never adds the Y item
- [Free gift not adding to cart shopify](https://ordermax.io/blog/free-gift-not-adding-to-cart-shopify/): why a free gift is missing from the cart; native discounts never insert items, plus out-of-stock gifts and threshold-unit mismatches
- [Shopify discount not combining](https://ordermax.io/blog/shopify-discount-not-combining/): Shopify's product/order/shipping discount classes, per-discount combination settings (off by default), and why stacking is usually a margin mistake
- [Automatic discount not applying shopify](https://ordermax.io/blog/automatic-discount-not-applying-shopify/): twelve-point checklist for a silent automatic discount: active-discount limits, timezones, market scope, collection membership, sales channels
